name: FreshRSS
description: A news reader that lives on the NAS and keeps your feeds, read state and stars in one place instead of in a phone app's silo. FreshRSS fetches RSS/Atom feeds on its own schedule and gives every device the same unread list. The first visit runs the installer and creates the administrator account; the UI opens in its own EthOS window on port 8085, and feeds and articles are stored in a package volume.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.1: the web UI listens on host port 8085 instead of 8080, which is claimed by many dev servers (the container still serves on 80). 1.0.0: first release — FreshRSS 1.30.4 pinned, SQLite database and feed cache in a package volume that survives updates, web UI on port 8080 (own login, created by the first-visit installer) and a container healthcheck. Needs outbound internet access to fetch feeds.
